status: Frozen for the user-authorized full-data baseline seed 13. B must match this protocol and validate R-Drop; if shared settings change, rerun affected conditions.
last_update_policy: Keep all rows; flush at epoch end; average microbatch losses weighted by their actual row counts. Final update of a full epoch has 4 rows.
sampling: Independent Python Random(seed + zero_based_epoch).shuffle; no global dropout RNG consumption; no replacement within each epoch.

scheduler.step_order: optimizer then scheduler; initial warmup LR is zero, following the author schedule convention

loss_contract.kl_reduction: sum over classes then mean over examples, computed in float32 with gradients through both distributions
loss_contract.alpha_zero: still two stochastic forwards and two CE terms; not numerical equality to baseline
loss_contract.source_note: B must adapt the pinned author's bert_kl implementation and document the CE/KL normalization change; original source is unchanged in step 4.

cost_reporting.updates: Actual optimizer.step calls; abort and retain failed-run artifacts on nonfinite gradients or AMP skips. Initial warmup LR=0 still counts as one call.
cost_reporting.examples_seen: training sample visits, including later epochs; distinct IDs recorded separately
cost_reporting.encoder_example_passes: counts duplicate R-Drop passes; not FLOPs
cost_reporting.train_seconds: CUDA-synchronized full training loop including update checks, sample selection/transfers, hook counting and logging; excludes preprocessing, evaluation, save and reload.
cost_reporting.formal_note: Use the identical training_core.py and logging interval for all conditions. Report instrumented wall-clock training cost, not pure kernel time. Keep first-step startup overhead.
cost_reporting.secondary_timer: Sum of synchronized update-body durations from train_update; excludes outer-loop logging and bookkeeping. Do not substitute it for total training wall time.
cost_reporting.gpu_memory: Reset CUDA peaks immediately before training; record allocated and reserved bytes before evaluation.

formal.checkpoint_selection: last update for every condition and seed; no best-dev checkpoint selection
